title: Song title: music video
brief: An instrumental track, 2:40. A city at night without performers. Feeling: alone but free. Every shot appears once.

promise.text: Every clip appears once. No people, no text, no signs. One motion and one camera move per shot. Night to dawn.

style: Cinematic night still, wet streets, sodium gold and teal light, 35 mm, photoreal, 16:9.

concepts.title: Night to dawn
concepts.logline: An empty city lives through one night, and the song ends on the first light.
concepts.image: Steam rising off a wet road at sunrise.
concepts.fit: Light, weather and water, no people.

concepts.title: Neon river
concepts.logline: A river carries the camera through the city.

concepts.title: Last train
concepts.logline: One empty train ride from the last stop to the sea.
concepts.image: The sea at dawn through the train window.
